# Agentic Budget Router MCP

Paid remote MCP for agentic workflow budget quotes, policy checks, spend approvals, usage receipts, and cost evidence exports.

Website: https://agenticbudgetrouter.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://agenticbudgetrouter.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://agenticbudgetrouter.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/agentic-budget-router-mcp

Use case: Route agentic workflow spend through quotes, policy gates, and receipts.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: quote_agentic_budget, check_budget_policy, request_spend_approval, issue_spend_receipt, export_usage_evidence
